deadline.value: The central ELLIS call closes 31 October 2026 (23:59 AoE). The Freiburg lab page gives 15 November, which conflicts; the earlier date is recorded.
deadline.quote: Apply by 31 October 2026 to join the ELLIS PhD Program in 2027

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants name preferred advisors in the ELLIS portal; the lab page states no separate contact rule.

funding.value: The lab hires PhD candidates on a full-time salaried scale (TV-L E13, 100%).
funding.quote: The salary scale for full-time positions is TV-L E13, 100%

entry_route.value: The ELLIS call asks for BSc and MSc transcripts but does not state whether a Master's is required.

notes: The lab hires PhD candidates solely through the ELLIS PhD Program (ML lab page). The ELLIS application needs a CV, BSc and MSc transcripts, and 2 to 3 referees who submit references by a later date. The PhD degree must come from a European institution, and each student needs a 6-month exchange with a secondary advisor. The ELLIS call is not a university page, so verify the deadline on the portal.
name: ELLIS PhD Program (Freiburg ML Lab)
